tests that stayed green under mutation

evals.name: wheelie-bin-medium-sections
evals.prompt: Model the Hannover Abfallwirtschaft grey wheelie bin from photos so it looks like the real one. It is just street dressing in the runner, medium detail is enough.
evals.expected_output: Gate A recommends class medium + sections loop; a curved-body build (lathe/loft) with a separate lid pivot; <= 12k tris, 1024^2; no parts loop needed; at most one combined B+C gate.
evals.tests: curved/organic shapes, sections loop alone, moving part (lid)

evals.name: tram-hero-custom-parts
evals.prompt: Make a really detailed replica of a Hannover Stadtbahn TW 3000 for the hero moment at the end of the level, budget is not a concern up to about 40k triangles.
evals.expected_output: Gate A offers custom class (40k, 2048 or 4096), parts loop with same-named sections in every key photo, loop on both key photos, escalation only for parts that hit the round limit.
evals.tests: custom class above 25k, long object, few clean side views, parts loop

evals.name: weak-photo-pack
evals.prompt: Model the Aegidienkirche ruin from photos. I only found two photos on Commons, both from the same corner.
evals.expected_output: Gate A flags that no true second angle exists, asks whether to search more or accept estimates marked 'estimate' in spec sources; does not extrapolate hidden faces silently.
evals.tests: missing key photo, estimate marking, user-visible Gate A questions

evals.name: raise-class-later
evals.prompt: Continue the finished Kroepcke clock: it now sits at the end of the track, raise it from replica to custom 35k triangles and add the missing leg rib detail.
evals.expected_output: Budget in spec.json is raised at the gate; only the affected parts (legs) get another parts-loop round; tests read the new tri_budget from the spec; no full rebuild of other parts.
evals.tests: raising the class later, targeted re-loop
